data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE tier). ROOT_CAUSE: _phase_poll (merge-to-main-pr.sh lines 1144-1294 Step 2 at 1256-1279) checks only .state for MERGED, never mergeStateStatus. When mergeStateStatus==BEHIND (another PR merged to main after this PR was created, with 'require branches up-to-date' branch protection), the poll loop runs until timeout with no recovery. _phase_conflict_resolution (line 1332) only handles CONFLICTING, returns 0 for BEHIND. All 5 hypothesis tests confirmed. Fix: add _phase_branch_update phase calling gh pr update-branch when BEHIND, cap 3 attempts, called both pre-poll and inside poll loop. testing_mode=RED.
